occurrences.text: For out of the heart proceed evil thoughts, murders, adulteries, fornications, thefts, false witness, blasphemies:
For from within, out of the heart of men, proceed evil thoughts, adulteries, fornications, murders,
And the scribes and Pharisees brought unto him a woman taken in adultery; and when they had set her in the midst,
Now the works of the flesh are manifest, which are these; Adultery, fornication, uncleanness, lasciviousness,

source: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890) and Concise Dictionaries (1894), public domain; JSON by Open Scriptures (CC BY-SA).
